snippet.title: Under The Eye - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo and Wishlist UNDER THE EYE on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4339260/Under_the_Eye/

UNDER THE EYE is a psychological horror card game set in the last day of a falling authoritarian empire. Will you survive to see it's demise?

Join the official Discord here: https://discord.gg/mMjwGJswte

#UnderTheEye #indiegame #psychologicalhorror #cardgame #deckbuilder #indiedev #psx
